content: {"like":["Sci‑fi dramas with gritty handheld camerawork and character‑driven plots (e.g., Battlestar Galactica).","Western epics that showcase strong, well‑cast characters and sweeping cinematography (e.g., True Grit).","Movies grounded in realistic science and subtle storytelling, emphasizing adult themes (e.g., Interstellar).","Historical or period pieces that reconstruct settings vividly (e.g., Pompeii).","High‑definition releases that preserve visual and audio fidelity (e.g., Blu‑ray versions of Star Wars)."],"dislike":["Sci‑fi series with clunky ship tech and washed‑out visuals (e.g., Battlestar Galactica).","Films with over‑stuffed plots and excessive, purposeless characters (e.g., Jupiter Ascending).","Movies featuring wooden performances that drag scenes (e.g., Pompeii with Kiefer Sutherland).","Shows or films that rely heavily on profanity or harsh language (e.g., Thick of It).","Releases with poor packaging or design that damages discs (e.g., Mad Men complete collection)."]}
